title: Customers who never bought stationery
statementMd:
List customers who have **not** ordered any Stationery product (customers with no orders count).

Expected columns: `name`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT c.name FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND p.category = 'Stationery');
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
